notes: Wooden table with benches: the table only, turned so its length runs across the stage. The model is plain blocks (186 faces) proportioned 6.19 x 2.03 x 3.66, i.e. a low wide table: stretched to the box (uniform on w it would be 0.59 high and 1.06 deep), which only thickens the square legs a little. Its WoodFine22 textures are not in the download (the .blend links them, unpacked, and its material is a node group paint cannot reach), so the FBX of the same model is used and painted a plain scrubbed pine.
